scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client "npm run dev -w @trustvault/server" "npm run dev -w @trustvault/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @trustvault/server && npm run build -w @trustvault/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @trustvault/server && npm run typecheck -w @trustvault/client
